scenarios.name: Default Time Selected
scenarios.trigger: User clicks the widget and does not change the time slot — default (e.g. 9 AM) is kept.
scenarios.popup: e.g. Confirmation toast: 'You're all set! We'll remind you at 9 AM.'
scenarios.backend: e.g. ea_reminder_set event fired with time=default; cron job scheduled for 09:00 daily; DB row inserted in reminders table.

scenarios.name: Custom Time — Same Day
scenarios.trigger: User picks a specific hour slot from the 24-hour list before the current time has passed for today.
scenarios.popup: e.g. Toast: 'Got it — reminding you at 3 PM today.'
scenarios.backend: e.g. ea_reminder_set event fired with time=custom, day=today; cron scheduled for selected hour; existing default row updated, not duplicated.

scenarios.name: Custom Time — Next Day
scenarios.trigger: User picks an hour slot that has already passed for today, so it rolls to tomorrow.
scenarios.message: e.g. 'That time's already passed today — reminder set for tomorrow at 3 PM instead.'
scenarios.backend: e.g. Same as above but next_run_date = tomorrow; flag rollover=true logged for analytics.

scenarios.name: User Dismisses Widget Without Selecting
scenarios.trigger: User clicks the close (X) icon on the widget without picking a time.
scenarios.backend: e.g. ea_widget_dismiss event fired; widget suppressed for this session/day per frequency cap rule.

scenarios.name: Guest (Not Logged In) Clicks Widget
scenarios.trigger: Widget click happens while IS_LOGGED_IN is false.
scenarios.message: e.g. 'Log in to set your reminder.'
scenarios.popup: e.g. Login modal shown instead of time picker.
scenarios.backend: e.g. No reminder row created; ea_widget_click event fired with logged_in=false for funnel tracking.
